title: Black January
summary: On the night of 19–20 January 1990, Soviet troops entered Baku under an emergency decree signed in Moscow and fired on civilians. Azerbaijan's official count is 147 civilians killed and about 800 injured. Independent monitors judged the force excessive, and the crackdown deepened the independence movement.

uncertainty.note: Troops entered late on 19 January; most killing is dated 20 January. Violence continued into February per HRW.

where.historical_name: Baku, Azerbaijan Soviet Socialist Republic, USSR

importance.justification: Soviet military crackdown in a republic capital during the USSR's final years, central to Azerbaijani national memory.

audience_note: Concerns the killing of civilians, including reports of shooting at ambulances; death tolls differ by source.
